court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
appellants: Ananya Radhakrishnan Krishnalaya Avai Shamanmugam Salai, Royapettah
respondents: Union of India, Honble Union Home Minister Ministry of Home Affairs Government of India and Others
advocates: For Respondents: Mr. A. Kumaraguru, Senior Panel Counsel, for the first respondent
Mr. Mohammed Fayaz Ali, Government Pleader, for respondents 2 and 3
prayer: Prayer: Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India for issuance of a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to condemn the relegation of Tamil Thaai Vaazhthu to the third position during the recent swearing-in ceremony of the Honble Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu and other Ministers of Legislative Assembly held on 10-5-2026 despite absence of any express constitutional, statutory of executive prohibition against commencing State Functions with the State Song of Tamil Nadu.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioner seeks to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to file a fresh petition with proper particulars, if so advised.

2. In view of the same, the writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn, with the aforesaid liberty. There will be no order as to costs.
